note: Family-owned campground at 28 Joy Bridge Rd, Lakemont, ~3 mi N of Tallulah Gorge off US-441, on the Tallulah River (swim and tube at your own risk). Tent shelters, chalets, a river cabin and a group shelter alongside the RV sites; bluegrass some Saturday nights. --Claude
summary: Operator site + its Wix booking engine: 15 RV sites + 1 tent/RV site, 30 A (50 A at #4, #6A, #25) with water, sewer at the non-river and long-term sites, dump station, showers, camp store, no laundry; $45 a night every RV site (weekly $270); open Apr 1 - Nov 1; 2-night holiday minimum (river sites 2 nights on weekends too). Note trimmed of hookups/count/RV Life text. Google 4.7 stars / 216 reviews, phone 706-782-1625 matches. Under the gate. Pin ~150 m east of the site rows (within tolerance; Google 34.77766,-83.39957 sits on them).
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (stored not waterfront): the operator lists RV sites #7, #8, #9, #10 and #12 as on the Tallulah River ('a pavilion overlooking the river', '#9 ... is on the river', '#10 ... on the river but view of river is obstructed'). Imagery shows the site row along the north bank between US-441 and the river, pads at the bank west of Joy Bridge Rd; the river there is ~20-28 m wide, so 'creekside' by the size rule. Needs the gate's site-level check (bank height, screening) before any upgrade.
Long-stay share: 4 of the 15 RV sites (#17-#19, #21-B) are 'typically for long term guests'; all are offered nightly in the engine at $45, so test 4 passes.
